searchText: hello, I have a smol questions (actually two). first: is the bitlist approach introduced in altair yielding the same results as the whole phase0 procedures? aka. does it HEAD, TARGET and SOURCE yield same validator indicies as the pending attestations approach? 2) out of curiosity, who made the Phase0 specs? this is "historical" curiosity and what were the dynamics with altair fork? phase0 and altair rewards processing aren’t equivalent, e.g. Altair introduced the notion of the source reward only being payable if the attestation is included within 5 slots Phase0 was designed by the same EF research team we know and love. Altair was a “practice run” for the Merge which we used to introduce some accounting reform after lessons learned on mainnet Discussion for E-star name for Consensus Layer upgrade after Deneb: https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/e-star-name-for-consensus-layer-upgrade-after-deneb/13248 *Inspired by listening to todays ACD-C call. _(Apologies if I am stepping on the process for selecting star upgrade names as I’m not a core dev)_ the sooner we choose the better IMO! thanks will try to make sense of phase0 specs then. thank you 🙂
